name: page-source-link
title: Page Source Link
description: A PageSource adapter for RFC 8288 `Link` headers, as GitHub and many REST APIs send them: page numbers with an estimate from `last` and an exact total on the last page, or cursors that follow `next` and `prev`.
docs: `linkHeaderSource({ key, getId, request, read, position, pageParam, sizeParam, base })`: `request(call)` fetches `call.url` when set (cursor mode follows the links) or your endpoint with `call.query`, and returns the `Response` itself so the header can be read. `position: "page"` (default) sends `?page=2&per_page=25` and reads the total from the links; `"cursor"` follows them. `read(body)` finds the rows when the body isn't the array. `parseLinkHeader(header)` reads any `Link` header into its relations (quoted parameters, several relations per link, commas inside URIs).
